summary.text: Harry Gold is the Democratic candidate for Delaware State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Gerald Hocker.
A retired educator and corporate training leader who lives in Bethany Beach, he is secretary of the Sussex County Democratic Committee.

paragraphs.text: Harry Gold earned a high school diploma from Pennsbury High School, a bachelor's degree from Temple University in 1973 and a graduate degree from Fairfield University in 1976.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Gold said he began as a special education teacher, led the opening of a school for drug and alcohol counselors, and moved into corporate training, finishing as Leader of Organizational Learning for more than 20,000 employees.
He said he serves on the Phase Affairs Council of Sea Colony, as secretary of the Sussex County Democratic Committee, and as president of the Shore Democrats.

Gold listed his campaign priorities as requiring new development to pay for the infrastructure it requires, protecting water and the coast, including removing lead and PFAS from drinking water, and a stronger democracy that offers voters a real choice.
